hooks.name: SQL quick check on save
hooks.description: When the agent saves a .sql file, run a fast correctness check and report only real problems.

action.prompt: Quick check of the SQL file just saved. Look only for high-severity issues from the sql-review checklist: joins that fan out (non-unique keys on one side), non-deterministic ROW_NUMBER or FIRST_VALUE ordering, NOT IN against a nullable subquery, WHERE filters on outer-joined columns, BETWEEN on timestamps, missing filters on partition columns of large tables, and SELECT * before a join. If you find any, list them in at most five one-line bullets with line numbers and suggest running #sql-review. If there are none, say nothing at all. Do not edit the file.
